title: Hysab Kytab v1.0.9
message: Isolated floating Assistant overlay (no background app launch), permanent mic cutoff fix, push-to-talk (hold to speak / tap to speak), and soft navigation bar elevation.
changelog: Isolated Assistant Overlay: Holding Home launches only the floating assistant overlay without opening the main app
Fixed Speech Recognition Lifecycle: Mic works reliably every time without dying
Push-to-Talk (Hold to speak, release to send) + Tap to toggle voice input
Soft navigation bar elevation: input box stays cleanly above Android buttons
